ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: <image1> When appreciating the “Ashima landscape” in the picture, what should be noted in the choice of viewing position?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the left side of the picture is labeled “Ashima landscape”; in the scene there are several towering stone pillars, and the combined outer contours of the stone pillars resemble a human figure, rather than an ordinary overall panoramic landscape. Then reason: this kind of pictographic or modeling-type landscape can only easily present the image of “Ashima” in the contours of the stone pillars from a certain suitable viewing angle. Therefore, in the choice of viewing position, one should stand at a fixed viewing angle or place where this image can be seen.

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧标注为“阿诗玛景观”，画面里是几根高耸的石柱，石柱的外形轮廓组合起来类似人物形象，而不是普通的整体全景景观。再推理：这种象形或造型类景观，只有在某个合适视角下，石柱轮廓才容易呈现出“阿诗玛”的形象。因此在观赏位置的选择上，应站在能看出该形象的固定视角或地点。
